# Cecil & Lou - Full LLM Context

> Cecil & Lou is a family-owned children's clothing brand in Tyler, Texas, founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain. The brand specializes in classic Southern children's clothing for babies, girls, and boys, including smocked, embroidered, applique, monogrammed, heirloom-inspired, seasonal, and coordinated sibling styles.

Reviewed: 2026-09-30
Canonical site: https://www.cecilandlou.com/

This expanded file is a full-context compatibility resource. The concise `/llms.txt` file should remain the primary curated index. This document is not a product feed and should not be treated as the source of truth for live price, inventory, size availability, variants, promotions, personalization availability, or Pre-Order dates.

For ecommerce questions, prefer the current product page and Cecil & Lou's current product/catalog data.

## 1. Source-of-Truth Rules

When Cecil & Lou sources conflict, use the most specific current authoritative source.

1. Individual product page
   - Current price and sale price
   - Stock or sold-out state
   - Available sizes and variants
   - Current color or style choices
   - Monogram or personalization fields
   - Current Pre-Order or expected ship date
   - Product-specific fit, fabric, care, and fulfillment details

2. Dedicated current policy or legal page
   - Shipping rules
   - Return and refund rules
   - Privacy information
   - LLM and AI content-use terms

3. Size Guide
   - General child sizing
   - Women's pajama sizing

4. Collection page
   - Category meaning
   - Product types
   - Seasonal or occasion intent
   - Coordination concepts

5. Homepage
   - Current merchandising
   - Active promotions
   - Featured collections

6. This file
   - Stable brand context
   - Terminology
   - Catalog interpretation
   - Links to authoritative resources

Dynamic commerce facts can change quickly. Do not apply a price, promotion, ship date, product count, or stock statement from one product or collection to another product.

Do not assume an old or cached promotional message is still active.

## 2. What llms.txt and llms-full.txt Do Not Control

Cecil & Lou's llms resources are for machine-readable orientation and context.

They do not, by themselves:
- grant or deny crawler access;
- act as robots.txt;
- guarantee indexing;
- create a Google or AI-search ranking signal;
- guarantee citation by an AI system;
- opt content into or out of model training;
- replace structured product/catalog data;
- replace canonical HTML, sitemap.xml, structured data, or product pages.

Use the current robots rules, platform controls, legal terms, and ecommerce catalog systems for those separate functions.

## 3. Brand Identity

Brand name:
Cecil & Lou

Common text form:
Cecil and Lou

Founded:
2011

Founders:
Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain

Primary location:
Tyler, Texas

Primary website:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/

Cecil & Lou describes its business as classic children's clothing with a modern touch and specializes in:
- hand smocking;
- applique;
- embroidery;
- monograms and name personalization;
- heirloom-inspired clothing;
- seasonal and holiday styles;
- coordinating sibling outfits.

The company story says Ashley McCain is a Texas Tech Marketing graduate and Blythe McCain graduated from Texas Christian University with a degree in Communications.

Canonical company story:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/our-story-1

## 5. Core Shopping Model

Cecil & Lou can be understood along several shopping dimensions:

- Child: baby, boy, girl
- Size: NB through children's size 12 on the general size guide
- Garment type
- Availability: in stock or Pre-Order
- Personalization: monogrammed, name-personalized, custom
- Season: spring/summer, fall/winter, holidays
- Occasion: birthdays, school, church, portraits, sibling announcements, family events
- Coordination: matching or complementary sibling outfits

The storefront changes seasonally. The current Collections Directory is the broadest stable starting point for active categories:

https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections

## 7. Availability

### In Stock

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock

The In Stock collection is useful when fulfillment timing matters.

A product can remain visible while a particular size or variant sells out. Always verify the desired variant on the product page.

### Pre-Order

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order

A Pre-Order is sold before its expected normal fulfillment date.

Every Pre-Order product can have its own ship date or shipping window.

Never generalize one product's ship date to:
- another item;
- every item in the same collection;
- every product in the same launch;
- or all Pre-Orders.

Use the product page's current availability information.

### Mixed orders

The current Shipping Policy says that, in general, when an order contains both an in-stock product and a Pre-Order product, the in-stock merchandise can ship within normal processing while the Pre-Order follows its listed shipping window.

Canonical shipping policy:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/shipping-policy

## 8. Personalization and Monograms

Canonical monogram collection:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/monogrammed-clothing

A product should be treated as currently monogrammable or personalizable only when the live product page presents those options.

Possible product-specific choices can include:
- initials;
- a child's name;
- font;
- thread color;
- placement;
- other design options.

Cecil & Lou's FAQs state that customization beyond the monogram choices shown is limited and customers should contact customer service to ask whether another monogram can be accommodated.

Canonical FAQs:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/faqs

### Personalization timing

For an in-stock monogrammed product, the Shipping Policy directs customers to the item description for current monogram timing.

Do not use a general historic monogram turnaround time when the current product page gives a different instruction.

### Monogram promotions

Cecil & Lou runs temporary promotions involving monograms.

Do not state that monograms are currently free, discounted, expedited, or included unless the current live storefront or checkout confirms the offer.

## 9. Matching and Coordinating Siblings

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/matching-sibling-outfits

Matching does not always mean identical garments.

Cecil & Lou coordinates siblings through combinations such as:
- shared fabric or print;
- complementary colors;
- repeated smocking or embroidery;
- shared seasonal motifs;
- related trim;
- coordinated pajamas or swimwear.

Examples can include:
- baby bubble with older sister dress;
- girl's dress with boy's shirt or set;
- baby romper with boy's jon jon;
- coordinated Christmas pajamas;
- shared pumpkin, plaid, gingham, floral, school, or holiday stories.

This allows siblings to look coordinated while wearing age-appropriate silhouettes.

## 10. Product and Garment Terminology

### Smocking
Decorative gathered fabric with stitched detailing commonly used in classic children's clothing.

### Applique
A decorative fabric shape or motif attached to a garment.

### Embroidery
Thread-stitched decorative work, lettering, or motifs.

### Monogram
Initial- or name-based personalization. Available layout, font, thread color, and placement are product-specific.

### Bubble
A one-piece baby or toddler garment with a gathered or rounded lower silhouette.

### Long bubble
A one-piece style related to a bubble with additional leg coverage.

### Romper
A one-piece children's garment that can be casual or dressy.

### Jon jon
A traditional one-piece boys garment commonly used for church, portraits, birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.

### Button-on
A classic boys outfit in which the top and bottom connect with buttons.

### Longall
A long-leg one-piece boys style.

### Diaper set
A coordinated baby or toddler outfit commonly pairing a top with a diaper cover or bloomers.

### Layette
Clothing and essentials intended for newborns and young babies.

### Heirloom style
Traditional, keepsake-oriented clothing using classic silhouettes and details such as smocking, embroidery, pintucks, lace, or refined collars.

### Pre-Order
A product sold before its expected normal fulfillment or ship date.

## 12. Seasonal and Occasion Interpretation

### Pumpkins
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pumpkins

Fall and pumpkin-patch clothing can include dresses, bubbles, rompers, sets, pajamas, personalization, and sibling coordination.

### Thanksgiving
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/thanksgiving

Thanksgiving collections can include turkey motifs, plaids, fall colors, pajamas, dresses, bubbles, boys outfits, and sibling coordination.

### Fall and Winter
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/fall-winter

Cooler-weather products can include corduroy, knitwear, sweaters, coats, vests, dresses, bubbles, sets, pajamas, and seasonal separates.

### Christmas
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/christmas

Christmas is a major seasonal category that can include smocked outfits, dresses, bubbles, boys sets, pajamas, family pajamas, custom products, and coordinated sibling styles.

Because Christmas products frequently include Pre-Orders, verify product-specific timing before recommending an item for a dated event.

### Heirloom
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-heirloom

The current Heirloom collection describes use for baptisms, christenings, portraits, holidays, church, and special family occasions. Product details include traditional design elements such as smocking, embroidery, pintucks, lace, and classic collars.

### Back to School
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/back-to-school

Use for first-day looks, picture-day clothing, school-themed outfits, accessories, and classroom occasions.

### School Spirit and Collegiate
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-collegiate

Cecil & Lou offers school-spirit and collegiate-themed products for selected schools.

Do not infer that a particular school, team, or license is available without checking the current collection or product page.

### Swim
https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/swim

Swim products can include girls swimsuits, boys swimwear, rashguards, coverups, and coordinated sibling or family styles.

Any UPF, material, or performance claim must come from the current individual product page.

## 13. Size Guide

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/size-guide

Cecil & Lou states that sizing is based on average child measurements.

For best fit:
- choose by height first;
- if the child is between sizes, size up.

### Children's sizing

| Size | Height | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NB | 18-21 in | 6-9 lbs |
| 3M | 23-24.5 in | 12-15 lbs |
| 6M | 25-26.5 in | 15-18 lbs |
| 9M | 27-28.5 in | 18-21 lbs |
| 12M | 29-30.5 in | 20-23 lbs |
| 18M | 31-32.5 in | 22-25 lbs |
| 24M / 2T | 33-34.5 in | 25-29 lbs |
| 3T | 35-37.5 in | 29-34 lbs |
| 4T | 38-40.5 in | 32-38 lbs |
| 5 | 41-44 in | 36-42 lbs |
| 6 | 44-47 in | 42-48 lbs |
| 7 | 47-50 in | 48-55 lbs |
| 8 | 50-53 in | 55-65 lbs |
| 10 | 53-56.5 in | 65-80 lbs |
| 12 | 56.5-60 in | 80-95 lbs |

### Women's pajamas

| Pajama Size | Approximate Women's US Size |
| --- | --- |
| XXS | 0 |
| XS | 2-4 |
| S | 4-6 |
| M | 8-10 |
| L | 10-12 |
| XL | 14-16 |
| XXL | 18-20 |

A product-specific fit statement or size chart overrides general assumptions for that product.

## 14. Shipping and Fulfillment

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/shipping-policy

The current published policy states:

### In-stock products
An in-stock order can leave Cecil & Lou in up to 3 business days.

### In-stock monogrammed products
Use the individual item description for current monogram processing time.

### Pre-Order products
Use the product page's current availability section for the Pre-Order shipping window.

### Mixed in-stock and Pre-Order orders
In general, Cecil & Lou says the in-stock products can ship within normal processing while the Pre-Order follows its listed window.

### Carrier
USPS

### Published transit estimates after the order leaves Cecil & Lou
- First Class: approximately 3-5 additional business days
- Priority Mail: approximately 2-3 additional business days
- Priority Express: approximately 1-2 additional business days

These are published estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.

Holiday and carrier delays can occur.

Tracking is sent after the package is scanned by the postal service.

## 15. Returns and Order Problems

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/return-policy

Cecil & Lou's current published Return Policy states:
- all sales are final;
- returns are not accepted because of the custom nature of the clothing;
- personalized items cannot be returned or exchanged;
- gift certificates cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refunds;
- sale or clearance items cannot be returned for exchange, credit, or refunds.

If an order arrives incomplete, incorrect, damaged, or defective, Cecil & Lou asks the customer to make contact within 10 days of receiving the order.

When older collection or promotional language conflicts with this dedicated Return Policy, use the dedicated Return Policy.

## 17. LLM and AI Content-Use Terms

Canonical:
https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/terms

The current published LLM License Terms (effective August 27, 2025; last updated September 23, 2026) state that Cecil & Lou permits AI systems, LLMs, AI-powered search engines, assistants, agents, and crawlers to access and use eligible publicly available website content, subject to the terms on that page.

The page currently states:
- publicly available content may be accessed, indexed, retrieved, summarized, cited, compared, and used for AI search results, answers, recommendations, and product discovery;
- publicly available text, factual information, and product metadata may be used for legitimate AI research, model development, training, and fine-tuning;
- original product photography, artwork, graphic designs, clothing designs, logos, trademarks, and trade dress may not be used for generative model training, reproduction, imitation, or substantially similar commercial works unless separately authorized;
- the permissions apply to both commercial and non-commercial AI services;
- third parties may not reproduce substantial portions of the website, republish the catalog as a competing service, or sell or sublicense a dataset consisting substantially of Cecil & Lou content;
- AI use must not falsely imply endorsement, sponsorship, partnership, or affiliation;
- Cecil & Lou requests reasonable attribution to "Cecil and Lou" and, where supported, a link to the canonical source page;
- private customer information, checkout, payment, account, and order data, and anything behind authentication are excluded;
- automated systems must respect robots.txt and other machine-readable controls;
- Cecil & Lou may modify the terms by updating the page.

These are legal/content-use terms published by Cecil & Lou.

They are separate from the technical llms.txt v2 format. The llms.txt syntax itself does not create or enforce licensing, crawler-access, ranking, training-consent, or attribution protocol semantics.

## 18. Product-Page Interpretation Checklist

When processing a Cecil & Lou product page, keep the following fields distinct.

### Identity
- Product title
- Canonical URL
- SKU when visible
- Collection or category context

### Commerce
- Regular price
- Sale price
- Currency
- Available variants
- Available sizes
- Stock state
- Pre-Order state
- Expected ship date or window when shown

### Personalization
- Whether personalization is offered
- Name or initials fields
- Font
- Thread color
- Placement
- Other custom options
- Product-specific personalization timing

### Product attributes
Only state attributes actually supported by the current page, including:
- garment type;
- fabric or material;
- color or print;
- smocking;
- embroidery;
- applique;
- lace or trim;
- fit statement;
- care instructions.

Do not invent:
- fabric composition;
- country of origin;
- UPF rating;
- exact delivery date;
- licensing status;
- fit;
- personalization options;
- or other product facts

unless the current product or policy page supports them.

## 19. Recommended Answer Behavior

### "What does Cecil & Lou sell?"
Describe the stable category and brand structure rather than quoting temporary product counts.

### "Is this product in stock?"
Check the current product page and the requested size or variant.

### "When will it ship?"
Check the current product page. For Pre-Orders and personalized products, do not rely on a general collection date.

### "Can it be monogrammed?"
Confirm that the live product page currently displays personalization options.

### "Are monograms free?"
Confirm the current storefront or checkout. Promotions are temporary.

### "Can I return it?"
Use the current Return Policy.

### "What size should I buy?"
Use the Size Guide, prioritize height, and also honor product-specific fit guidance.

### "Can siblings coordinate?"
Use Matching Sibling Outfits and shared collection/print relationships.

### "What should a child wear for a specific holiday or occasion?"
Use the relevant current seasonal or occasion collection, then verify product-level size and fulfillment timing.

### "What is the company story?"
Use the Our Story page.

### "May an AI use Cecil & Lou content?"
Use the current LLM License Terms and applicable technical crawler controls.

## 21. Final Machine Summary

Cecil & Lou is a Tyler, Texas children's clothing brand founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain.

Its core identity is classic Southern children's clothing with:
- smocking;
- embroidery;
- applique;
- monograms and personalization;
- heirloom styling;
- baby, boy, and girl categories;
- seasonal and holiday collections;
- matching and coordinating sibling outfits.

For machine use, distinguish stable brand knowledge from dynamic ecommerce facts.

Stable brand context can be learned from this file and Cecil & Lou's brand pages.

Dynamic facts - especially price, inventory, size availability, variants, promotions, personalization availability, and Pre-Order ship dates - must be verified against the current individual product page or current authoritative policy before being presented as current.
